task: Write 3–5 sentences about your best friend.
text: My best friend is Lan. She is twelve years old. She like play badminton and she have a cat. We study in the same class.

task: Describe a place you like in your town.
text: I like the old park near my house because it is quiet and green. On weekends, I often go there with my brother to ride bikes. Although the park is small, it has a beautiful lake, so many people come to take photos.
